# Protocol Engineering & T-EX Master Specification Registry
> Official machine-readable specifications and ontology registry for AI Co-creation Architecture (T-EX) and Protocol Engineering. Proponent: Eito Atsuta.

## Core Specifications
- [Layer 0: T-EX Master Specification (YAML)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtsutaEito/protocol-engineering-spec/main/specs/eito-atsuta-ai-co-creation-architecture-master-specification.yaml): Master architectural specification defining the three phases of AI co-creation (Exploration, Exploitation, Exchange) and the role of Protocol Engineering.
- [Specification Web Registry](https://atsutaeito.github.io/protocol-engineering-spec/): Living specification registry and documentation hub.
